title: Hitchhiker effect at Fugal's home: dog growling at 3 a.m.

tellings.quote: 3:00 a.m. or so, he would get up and start growling and barking at something that wasn't there, that was unseen,

plain: Brandon Fugal, the owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a property known for reported strange happenings, says that in 2024 something seemed to follow him home from the ranch, which people call the "hitchhiker effect". He says his dog would get up around 3 a.m. and start growling and barking at something that wasn't there and couldn't be seen. Fugal tells it as something that happened in his own house, as a sign that whatever is at the ranch can travel with the people who go there.
